addon.notes:
# New

### General
* Searching for items across "All Characters" view in Inventory now shows the total amount of items across all characters.
* Added a "Use One Everywhere" action that uses one of a usable item. Additionally, if the item exists in an accessible bag, connected characters will attempt to bring 1 of that item to their inventory to use it.
* You can now permanently remove a character from Alexandria tracking in the Settings section under "Characters". Logging in with the character again will re-register them.

### Watch List
* Low stock warnings now show globally and displays the name of the character who is running low on the supply.

### Bazaar
* Now allows click+drag multi select in My Bazaar.

### Augmentation
* Added preliminary support for augmenting through paid Dark Matter path for Geas Fete technique Augmentation. Allows configuring how many Dark Matter to spend, or all in inventory.

### Auction House
* Now supports sequential bidding up to 99 times up from 7 and includes a progress bar that can be stopped mid-process.

# Bugfixes
* Fixed a bug where Net Worth was only showing worth from characters who were currently online.
* Fixed a bug where the pop-out treasure pool overlay would disappear when toggling Always On Top.
* Fixed a bug where transparency and other settings were not saved properly for the treasure pool overlay.
* Fixed a bug where some stones in Divainy-Gamainy were not registered properly.
